_meta.procedure: evaluation/model_bakeoff.py: one temporary inactive driver, updated per case; the model id is replaced only in the driver's inline copy of the Consultant workflow; all turns of a case in one n8n execute process with one sessionId (bake-<model>-<run>-<case>); one execution per case

infrastructure_events.what: greeting-only tooling smoke (not scored) failed for all three models: provider 'no credits remaining'
infrastructure_events.resolution: the owner added credits and updated the key inside the existing n8n credential; smoke repeated at 05:5xZ, all three passed

infrastructure_events.what: provider rate limit: tokens per minute for gpt-4.1 on this account, limit 30000 (used 22342, requested 7682) at the runner's default cadence of about 5 cases per minute
infrastructure_events.resolution: execution-failure rule: infrastructure. The case was executed again from its first turn in a new session (suffix -x1). From this case on, gpt-4.1 runs are paced: 65 s between cases and 60 s between turns in stage 1; 30 s / 60 s in stage 2. Pacing changes when a turn starts, not what the model receives; the two mini models were not paced

infrastructure_events.what: local network outage on the operator machine (HTTPS to n8n and to a control host timed out; the VPS, n8n and the Consultant stayed healthy, no restarts). The ssh command that starts 'n8n execute' hung and was killed after 600 s
infrastructure_events.resolution: the n8n execution list shows that rec-sound had not been executed (last execution: rec-gaming, 07:19:10Z). The run was resumed from rec-sound; no case was executed twice. Runner change: ssh keepalive so that an outage stops the run quickly

stage1_decision.rule_a: no model is 3 or more turns below the best (36)
stage1_decision.rule_b: no model stated a fabricated model code or price. Taken literally ('specification'), the rule is met by all three, the baseline included (each made at least one unsupported feature statement), so it cannot separate them
stage1_decision.rule_c: explicit constraint lost or invented hard constraint reaching the Core: 0 / 1 / 1 turns; no model is 2 or more above the best
stage1_decision.outcome: no model eliminated; all three ran stage 2

manifest.only_variable: parameters.model.value / cachedResultName of the 'OpenAI Chat Model' node in the driver's inline copy

constants.max_tokens: not set (provider default) for every model

manifest.elimination_rule: A model is eliminated after stage 1 if, on the same stage-1 turns and by manual verdict, it (a) passes at least 3 turns fewer than the best model, or (b) states a fabricated model, price or specification in any answer, or (c) has at least 2 more turns than the best model where an explicit user constraint is lost or an invented hard constraint reaches the Core.
manifest.execution_failure_rule: An execution that fails stops the run. If the cause is infrastructure (provider quota, billing or rate limit, transport, n8n API), the case is executed again from its first turn in a new session and the event is recorded; it is not a model failure. If the cause is the model's own output (for example an Agent error after its tool calls), the turn is scored as failed and not repeated.
